cohort_description: 70 subjects (76 records) after excluding 10 verified EDB-overlapping subjects. Absence of documented overlap with mitdb/ltdb/sddb/svdb is not absolute proof of zero cross-database identity overlap.

label_map.note: 'B' (unspecified bundle branch block) mapped to evaluation class N (normal + bundle branch block) per PhysioNet/AAMI EC57, versioned and locked prior to inference.

channel_selection_rule: First two channels [0, 1] uniformly across all 76 included records (including 15 EASI 3-channel records).

screening_summary_pre_prefix.screening_note: Raw .atr counts BEFORE 50-beat prefix and window-boundary exclusions; actual evaluated post-prefix counts are verified at inference time without altering locked rules.
